reason: The owner rejected Zig/Yuku as the production language core; it does not satisfy the intended Rust/OXC-crate integration even though it is native and fast.
summary: Retained T009 as prototype evidence only. Its one-call native boundary, correctness fixtures, Markless accounting, tarball isolation, and performance measurements inform the replacement, but the implementation cannot ship as OXC for TSRX. T010 now qualifies a Rust-native, published-OXC-crate architecture before product code is replaced.
disposition: Keep prototype files temporarily as differential controls; remove or replace them only after the Rust implementation proves equivalent behavior and performance.
